name: English Mustard
siboNotes: English mustard is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it contains no fermentable carbohydrates and may have mild antimicrobial properties.
preparationTips: Mix mustard powder with water or vinegar just before serving for maximum heat
Store prepared mustard in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks
Start with small amounts as English mustard is significantly hotter than American yellow mustard
Add to marinades and dressings for flavor without FODMAPs
nutritionalHighlights: Contains antioxidant compounds from mustard seeds
Very low in calories and sodium compared to other condiments
Source of omega-3 fatty acids from mustard seeds
